ruleDefinitions.name: Tamper Windows Defender - ScriptBlockLogging
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects PowerShell scripts attempting to disable scheduled scanning and other parts of Windows Defender ATP or set default actions to allow. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Set\\-MpPreference.*") AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-dbaf\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-dbaf\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-dbm\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-dbm\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-dips\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-dips\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableArchiveScanning\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableArchiveScanning\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableBehaviorMonitoring\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableBehaviorMonitoring\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableBlockAtFirstSeen\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableBlockAtFirstSeen\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableCatchupFullScan\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableCatchupFullScan\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableCatchupQuickScan\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableCatchupQuickScan\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableIOAVProtection\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableIOAVProtection\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableRealtimeMonitoring\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableRealtimeMonitoring\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableRemovableDriveScanning\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableRemovableDriveScanning\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableScanningMappedNetworkDrivesForFullScan\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableScanningMappedNetworkDrivesForFullScan\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableScanningNetworkFiles\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableScanningNetworkFiles\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableScriptScanning\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-DisableScriptScanning\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-MAPSReporting\\ \\$false.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-MAPSReporting\\ 0.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-drdsc\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-drdsc\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-drtm\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-drtm\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-dscrptsc\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-dscrptsc\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-dsmndf\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-dsmndf\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-dsnf\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-dsnf\\ 1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-dss\\ \\$true.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-dss\\ 1.*"))) OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Set\\-MpPreference.*") AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*HighThreatDefaultAction\\ Allow.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*htdefac\\ Allow.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*LowThreatDefaultAction\\ Allow.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ltdefac\\ Allow.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ModerateThreatDefaultAction\\ Allow.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*mtdefac\\ Allow.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*SevereThreatDefaultAction\\ Allow.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*stdefac\\ Allow.*")))
